description: Unit tests for OLC commit history data model

tests.name: olchist_create_destroy
tests.description: Create a history, verify all fields, then destroy it

tests.name: olchist_archive
tests.description: Archive a changeset into history and verify the commit record

tests.name: olchist_eviction
tests.description: Verify oldest records are evicted when max_records is exceeded

tests.name: olchist_serialize_roundtrip
tests.description: Serialize and deserialize history, verify data integrity

tests.name: olchist_group_id
tests.description: Verify group ID is shared across multiple entity histories

tests.name: olchist_empty_changeset
tests.description: Verify empty changeset is not archived into history
